Honest answer: I don't know why batch 1 sits level with the later ones, and I won't guess at it. I've put the question to the team. They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.

That's fair, a code is no use to you.

So instead of the code, I've asked for $50 back to the card you paid with on this order. The team confirms that to your email when they're in tomorrow at 10am ET; it lands 3 to 5 business days after they issue it.

Nothing else changes, your Magic (address hidden), Power Kit and Duster still ship October 31.

Is the wait itself workable for you, or would you rather look at other options?
That's tolerable. It's not a block, but it helps, unlike the rest of this experience. Thanks.

Understood, and fair. The delay and the silence around it are on us, not on you.

Delivery notices and the team's reply both go to (email hidden), so worth whitelisting us, those mails have been landing in spam for people.

Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the Magic Miner 40T as your first one with us?
Price compared with th/s + it operating through a normal home outlet.

Makes sense, it's the cheapest per TH we sell and it runs off a standard outlet.

Was there another miner you were weighing it against before you ordered?
No, because the less expensive th/s options require a dedicated circuit.

That's a real constraint, and the 40T was the right pick for it. Thanks for telling me, it helps.

You're set: October 31 ship date, the $50 confirmed to your email tomorrow after 10am ET. A copy of this whole conversation comes to you by email once we're done here.
Just wondering, why did you tell me that this is the cheapest per th you sell, when it is not?
Read the punkhash 70t page

Fair catch, and I was wrong. The P. 70T is $1,100 for 70 TH/s, about $16 per TH, cheaper than the 40T's $20. I should have said the 40T is the cheapest per TH that runs on a normal household outlet, which is what you actually bought it for. The P. pulls 1.45 kW and needs its own circuit, so it was never an option for you.

Sorry for the sloppy line. Nothing on your order changes.
